aVmt.definition: is the total miles traveled by vehicles over segments in the specified geography over a given time period.

aVht.definition: measures the total time spent by vehicles traveling over segments in the specified geography over a given period of time.

aVhd.definition: is the cumulative delay experienced by vehicles, calculated as the difference between actual (congested) speed and free-flow speed.

aDis.definition: is the total length of segments, measured along its centerline, regardless of the number of lanes.

aLMl.definition: is the total length of lanes on roadways calculated by multiplying the length of a road segment by the number of lanes in that segment.

aTBM.definition: represents the total length of all transit routes multiplied by the number of buses for each route. Peak period is 6 hours of duration for a given day, and Off-Peak period is 10 hours of duration for a given day.

aRM.definition: is the length of a transit route with each direction represented separately in total.

aSTrip.definition: refer to the individual journeys made by people or vehicles from one location to another.

aDM.definition: is the maximum heirarchacal mode with commuter rail being the highest and local bus being the lowest.

aBd.definition: is the number of passengers boarding at a stop for trips moving in the production-to-attraction direction (eg., home to work for home-based work trips). Each transfer counts as a separate boarding, and each trip is recorded twice in the same direction to account for the return trip as well.

aAl.definition: is the number of passengers alighting at a stop for trips moving in the production-to-attraction direction (eg., home to work for home-based work trips). Each transfer counts as a separate alighting, and each trip is recorded twice in the same direction to account for the return trip as well.

aLn.definition: is the number of cross-section lanes.

aAT.definition: represents the relative density of surrounding development for on which freeflow speeds are based.

aFt.definition: is the type of roadway on which capacity is based.

aCT.definition: is the capacity for the entire period, which equals the number of lanes on the segment multiplied by the duration of the time period and the per hour per lane capacity.

aCp.definition: is the maximum number of vehicles that can pass through a single lane per hour.

main.legendTitle: Lane Hourly Capacity (vehicles per hour per lane)

aFS.definition: is the speed vehicles can travel under ideal, congestion-free conditions as measured in mph.

aVl.definition: is the total number of vehicles using the segment.

aRS.definition: is the modeled travel speed accounting for traffic conditions.

aXVc.definition: is the highest volume-to-capacity ratio modeled for the segment considering all functional groups, directions, and time periods.

main.valueExpression: var v  = $feature.dVal; if (v == null || v==0  ) { return 'nodata'  ; } else if (v< 0.7) { return 'class_00'; } else if (v< 0.8) { return 'class_01'; } else if (v< 0.9) { return 'class_02'; } else if (v< 1.0) { return 'class_03'; } else if (v< 1.1) { return 'class_r0'; } else if (v< 1.2) { return 'class_r1'; } else if (v< 1.3) { return 'class_r2'; } else if (v< 1.4) { return 'class_r3'; } else if (v< 1.5) { return 'class_r4'; } else if (v< 1.6) { return 'class_r5'; } else if (v< 1.7) { return 'class_r6'; } else if (v< 1.8) { return 'class_r7'; } else if (v< 1.9) { return 'class_r8'; } else if (v< 2.0) { return 'class_r9'; } else if (v>=2.0) { return 'class_b0'; }

compare_abs.valueExpression: var v  = $feature.dVal; if (v<=-1.00) { return 'class_1'; } else if (v< -0.50) { return 'class_2'; } else if (v< -0.15) { return 'class_3'; } else if (v< -0.05) { return 'class_4'; } else if (v<  0.05) { return 'class_5'; } else if (v<  0.15) { return 'class_6'; } else if (v<  0.50) { return 'class_7'; } else if (v<  1.00) { return 'class_8'; } else { return 'class_9'; }

aTP.definition: is the percent of total volume that is trucks.

aDF.definition: is the portion of total segment volume that is traveling in a specified direction.

aPF.definition: is the ratio of period volume to daily volume.

aFGs.definition: is the ratio of volume for functional group lanes to volume for all lanes.

aHP.definition: represents the total number of individuals living within a specific area.

aHV.definition: is the total number of occupied residential units.

aV.definition: is the total number of vehicles owned or available for use by households.

aWk.definition: is the number of individuals within the population who are employed and part of the workforce.

aE3.definition: is the distribution of employment across the three broad employment categories.

aE12.definition: is a more detailed division of employment statistics in twelve distinct categories.

aI.definition: is the mean income level of individuals or households within the area.

aSc.definition: is the total number of students enrolled in K-12 educational institutions within the specified area.

aR.definition: is the total number of passengers traveling on the transit segment across all routes using that segment.

aHd.definition: is the shortest time between vehicles of all routes on a segment.

aFq.definition: is the number of buses or trains passing through the segment per hour.

aTS.definition: is the average speed in mph of transit vehicles traveling on a segment.

a0.definition: represents the total number of trips starting from (production) or ending at (attraction) a zone, across all transportation modes.

aM.definition: includes all trips made using motorized transport, including cars, motorcycles, and public transit.

aA.definition: specifically refers to trips made using personal automobiles.

aT.definition: is the number of trips made using public transportation services, such as buses or trains.

aN.definition: encompasses trips made without the use of motorized vehicles, namely walking and bicycling.

aNM.definition: encompasses trips made without the use of motorized vehicles, namely walking and bicycling.

aW.definition: is specifically the number of trips made entirely on foot.

aB.definition: refers to trips made using only a bicycle.

aJA.definition: is the average number of jobs that are reachable to a resident within a typical commute.

aHA.definition: is the average number of households that are reachable to a business within a typical commute.

aJAr.definition: is the average number of jobs that are reachable to a resident within a typical commute divided by the average for the selected geography filter.

aHAr.definition: is the average number of households that are reachable to a business within a typical commute divided by the average for the selected geography filter.

aJL.definition: shows a comparison between congested auto access to jobs compared to freeflow access (Roadway Congestion) and straightline (Network Inefficiency).

aHL.definition: shows a comparison between congested auto access to households compared to freeflow access (Roadway Congestion) and straightline (Network Inefficiency).

aPMT.definition: is the total miles traveled by people produced or attracted to the specified geography over a given time period.

aPHT.definition: measures the total time spent by people traveling produced or attracted to the specified geography over a given period of time.

aPHD.definition: is the cumulative delay experienced by people, calculated as the difference between actual (congested) speed and free-flow speed.

aVMT.definition: is the total miles traveled by vehicles produced or attracted to the specified geography over a given time period.

aVHT.definition: measures the total time spent by vehicles traveling produced or attracted to the specified geography over a given period of time.

aVHD.definition: is the cumulative delay experienced by vehicles, calculated as the difference between actual (congested) speed and free-flow speed.

aTPMT.definition: is the total miles traveled by passengers on segments over a given period of time in the specified geography.

aTPHT.definition: is the total time spent by passengers traveling over a given period of time within the specified geography.

aColEmpToEnrolFactor.alias: College Employment to Headcount (no concurrent) Factor

aColEmpToTotempRatio.alias: College Employment (estimated) to TAZ Total Employment Ratio

aSLVol.definition: is the daily volume of trips whose path uses at least one link tagged with the chosen select-link group. Use the Select Link Group filter to switch between groups 1-4 or view all groups combined.
